patients.label: 61-year-old man with diabetes and hypertension and post-COVID-19 possible autoimmune encephalitis with transcortical sensory aphasia

identity_evidence.quote: A 61-year-old hypertensive and diabetic unvaccinated male

attribution_limitations: Source conflict: the discussion calls the CSF study normal, while the case presentation reports elevated CSF protein (66 mg/dl). Both sides are review_only. The detectable CSF SARS-Cov-2 antibodies are kept because the discussion itself cites them as intrathecal antibody evidence.

The case presentation dates the positive RT PCR to Day 2 of fever and the onset of behavioral change to Day 5, while the discussion states onset of symptoms after four days of testing positive. The day counts are not reconciled.

The discussion sentence reporting insular ribboning with temporal, basifrontal and thalamic changes names no modality; in the case presentation basifrontal involvement is a PET finding, not an MRI one.
The autoimmune encephalitis panel lists LGI2, which may be a misprint of LGI1; the printed name is kept.
